subject: Operational safety, failover playbook and evidence - RFP questions
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@stellaredge.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: StellarEdge Procurement <procurement@stellaredge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Operational safety and failover playbook - RFP questions

Sergio,

Thanks for your responses to the RFP so far. A few of our reviewers asked for more detail on operational safety, failover procedures, and evidence we can include in our procurement packet. Specifically: 

- Can you describe operator separation controls (who can execute failover, who can perform configuration changes) and how those actions are audited?
- For air-gapped / on-prem deployments: what is your recommended maintenance window and safe-patching procedure? How do you evidence signed patches and SBOMs for audits?
- Do you have a playbook for graceful shutdowns and operator-driven failover (including command examples, expected service windows, and rollback steps)?
- We need PDF or DOC artifacts we can attach to the procurement file; can you provide an example runbook and a short list of supporting evidence (signed SBOM, patch attestations, operator training records)?

Appreciate concise bullets and any example artifacts you can share this week — our legal and security teams need these for the next review. Proposed kickoff call Thursday if that works.

Best,
Anita Rao
Head of Platform Security
StellarEdge Health

------
Attachment: none in initial ask

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@stellaredge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational safety and failover playbook - RFP questions

Anita — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below and we attached a set of artifacts for your packet. See the Drive link and attachments for full examples. Happy to walk through on the call Thursday.

High-level bullets:
- Operator separation: Role-based access via RBAC tied to customer LDAP/AD. We recommend three operator roles: Viewer, Operator (runbooks/failover), and Admin (config changes). Only Operator+Admin can initiate failover; every action is logged with user, timestamp, command, and machine id. Audit logs are retained configurable (default 90 days, enterprise option 1 year).
- Failover playbook (attached): Step-by-step graceful failover with commands, expected latency impact, verification checks, and rollback steps. Includes a checklist for pre-failover validation and post-failover sanity tests.
- Air-gapped maintenance & patching: We support signed patch bundles (customer-hosted signing key or Redwood-signed packages). Workflow: pre-signed artifact -> operator offline transfer -> staged install -> integrity verification -> sign-off. We include SBOM snapshots with each patch and an immutable attestations file.
- Evidence bundle (attached): operator_safety_playbook_v1.pdf, failover_runbook_v1.docx, operator_training_matrix.csv, plus a sample SBOM snapshot (see Drive link).

Quick timeline: we can provide the annotated artifacts and a notarized SBOM snapshot by EOD Friday if you need the procurement packet this week.

Call slots Thursday: 10:00–10:30 PT or 15:00–15:30 PT. Which works?

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Field Engineering, Redwood Inference

------
Attachments: operator_safety_playbook_v1.pdf (stub), failover_runbook_v1.docx (stub), operator_training_matrix.csv (stub)

Thanks, Sergio — that looks promising. A couple of clarifications from our security reviewers (quoted inline):

> "We need more detail on the offline patch signing model — will StellarEdge retain customer keys? What is the sequence for signature verification?"

> "Can you provide an example audit record that shows an operator-initiated failover, sanitized for PII, so we can see the fields captured?"

> "If Redwood is providing signed artifacts for air-gapped installs, what escrow or key-rotation guarantees exist to ensure we don't end up with a stale key?"

Also we need a firm date for when the signed SBOM snapshot and patch_signoff_checklist will be available — legal wants those as PDFs in the procurement packet. Can Marissa or Irene confirm technical details and delivery timing?

Anita

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@stellaredge.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational safety and failover playbook - RFP questions

Hi Anita — Irene from Security/Compliance at Redwood. Answering the reviewer questions and confirming delivery timeline below.

1) Offline patch signing model:
- Options: (A) Customer-supplied signing keys (recommended): StellarEdge retains private keys in your HSM/KMS. You sign the update bundle before air-gap transfer. Redwood verifies signatures during install and records the key fingerprint in the attestation. (B) Redwood-signed packages: Redwood signs with our release key; we provide periodic key rotation notices and an escrow process — details below.
- Verification sequence: install agent verifies signature -> computes SHA256 of installed binaries -> compares SBOM entries -> writes immutable attestation record to local storage (and optional remote telemetry collector when connectivity resumes). Attestation includes timestamp, package hash, signer fingerprint, operator id.

2) Key escrow and rotation guarantees (if Redwood signs):
- Redwood will provide a key-rotation schedule (90-day rotation typical) and a signed rotation manifest. For enterprise contracts we offer key-escrow: an encrypted copy of the prior key material deposited with a third-party escrow provider (contractual SLA around retrieval). We also publish signed rotation manifests and DFARS-style change notices to customers.

3) Example audit record (sanitized):
- Timestamp: 2026-07-14T03:22:08Z
- Operator: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com (role: Operator)
- Action: initiate_failover
- Target cluster: se-stg-02
- Pre-checks: passed (cpu, kvcache, healthchecks)
- Command: /opt/redwood/bin/runbook execute failover --dry-run=false
- Result: success
- Post-checks: passed (latency, token-serve, error-rate)

We will sanitize PII and provide a redacted sample audit log entry in PDF format.

Delivery timeline:
- patch_signoff_checklist.xlsx -> attached now (spreadsheet stub).
- sbom_snapshot_20261101.json -> attached now (JSON stub).
- We will publish a signed PDF SBOM snapshot and a notarized patch attestation by EOD Wednesday, 2026-11-24. If you need an earlier notarized copy for procurement intake, we can provide an unsigned SBOM earlier and replace it with the notarized version prior to contract signature.

Follow-up: we can run the Thursday 10:00 PT slot for a 30-minute technical walkthrough. Agenda: 1) review failover runbook, 2) walk through patch signing/attestation sequence, 3) review sample audit record and evidence handoff.

Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

------
